text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when we went out for roadwork as 
part of training...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? That girl over there, is she—

text_block_list.name: Girl in School Uniform
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Shion-san! Um... please take this 
letter!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, thank you so much! ...Heheh, glad to 
see you're back in high spirits!
choice_data_list: Could it be you two know each other?

text_block_list.name: Girl in School Uniform
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. This is on my route to school, so we 
used to pass each other all the time. 
...One time, when I was crying, Shion-san 
called out to me."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Your crying face... looked so painful... I 
just couldn't help calling out to you.

text_block_list.name: Girl in School Uniform
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, *hic*... For this upcoming club 
tournament... I really, really wanted to 
be a starter. But I ended up on the 
bench..."

text_block_list.name: Girl in School Uniform
text_block_list.text:
Even though I practiced on my own until 
late, and even got advice from my 
upperclassmen...! I still couldn't beat my 
talented classmate!

text_block_list.name: Girl in School Uniform
text_block_list.text:
When I realized you can't succeed without 
talent... I felt so miserable... but I 
couldn't give up... I even found myself 
wishing she wasn't around...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah, that's true. Having someone's 
raw talent shoved in your face... really 
hurts.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Um. Would you mind keeping me company 
for just a bit?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting. Here's the 
flyer for the ballet. The lead is my dad, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"It's my dream! I want to seize the 
spotlight just like my dad. I'm aiming to 
be the protagonist of the racing world!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Still, Tracen Academy is full of 
Umamusume with overwhelming talent. No 
matter how hard I tried... I couldn't beat 
them.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm trying harder than 
anyone... Sometimes, I even resented them 
for it.

text_block_list.name: Girl in School Uniform
text_block_list.text: Shion-san...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"When that happens, I look at this flyer! 
Seeing my dad in all his glory... reminds 
me!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Just like Dad said, hard work always pays 
off. That's why I'm going to run again!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—I'm gonna prove it. That hard work can 
surpass talent. So... please watch my 
race.

text_block_list.name: Girl in School Uniform
text_block_list.text:
...I went to watch your race, Miss Shion. 
Just like you said... with your running, 
you showed me that hard work really does 
pay off.

text_block_list.name: Girl in School Uniform
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, the tears wouldn't stop... 
and from the bottom of my heart, I wanted 
to do my best too. I wrote all those 
feelings down in the letter!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I see... I'll gladly read your 
letter, then!

text_block_list.name: Girl in School Uniform
text_block_list.text:
"It was thanks to you that I got back on 
my feet. Shion-san—you are the star of the 
show to me!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ! I'm the main event...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll get back up as many times as it 
takes. So I can shine bright, like a true 
leading star!
